profiles.description: Transparency-register review: declarations are what registrants and officials filed, never influence findings

workflow_defaults.as_of: the register revision in force on the date by the register's own dates; latest when no date is given
workflow_defaults.unmatched_names: shown as the register string, marked unmatched
workflow_defaults.spend: the declared range with currency and period, never collapsed

vocabulary.link: an explicit register field or a reviewed assertion
vocabulary.candidate: a shared keyword or unreviewed proposal, never a link

profiles.description: Contest review: results as each authority published them, preliminary and certified kept apart, polls beside (never blended into) results

workflow_defaults.as_of: the result vintage in force on the date by the authority's publication date; latest when no date is given
workflow_defaults.unmatched_names: shown as the source string, marked unmatched
workflow_defaults.polls: per publisher series with fieldwork window and sample size; never averaged

vocabulary.vintage: one publication of a contest's result (preliminary, certified, recount or corrected)
vocabulary.poll reading: a publisher's estimate for a fieldwork window, never a result
vocabulary.assertion: a dated, cited statement about a succession or boundary change, kept beside conflicting ones

requires.reason: the bundle's own entry points use these operations

optional_features.description: Lobbying and transparency-register evidence: registrants, clients, declared interests, declared spend ranges, meetings with officials and register revisions, linked to legislative dossiers by explicit register fields or reviewed assertions, with reviewable identity matches and subscription monitors. Declarations as filed; no influence claim or point estimate.

requires.reason: the feature's own entry points use these operations
declarations are read beside the Political bundle's legislative dossiers
accepted and reverted matches are entity identity decisions
LEIs a register states are compared with LEI records
registrant and client matches use the reviewable identity state machine
lobbying monitors are knowledge subscriptions

optional_features.description: Election results and public-opinion series: contests with preliminary, certified, recount and corrected result vintages as published, candidates and lists with reviewable identity, poll series kept apart from results, constituency boundaries in the Geospatial store as of a date, user forecasts resolved only on certified results, news evidence without causal reading, and subscription monitors. No seat or outcome prediction, poll aggregate or causal claim.
